scope: Same-input MMLU-Pro FA-only service performance screen
source_and_configuration: Frozen identical inputs and payload hashes, independent processes and caches, common B1 compiler seed
aggregation: Median and full range of all three starts per arm; geometric mean of paired ON/OFF throughput ratios
selection: No highest-run selection. Compare median ON against existing per-metric B1; require matching favorable paired direction. Publish all runs and uncertainty limits.
excluded: Earlier incomplete, cold-cache and activation-diagnostic attempts are retained separately, not mixed into this cohort
